description: This Java class 'UserService' manages user-related operations within the internet banking microservice, including user creation, retrieval, and status updates, integrating with Keycloak for identity management, and interacting with a database repository.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Service class managing user creation, retrieval, and updates in the internet banking application, integrating with identity management and persistence layers.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user by verifying email, checking with an external banking service, registering in Keycloak, and saving to the database.

methods.name: readUsers
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of users, enriching each with data from Keycloak.

methods.name: readUser
methods.description: Fetches user details by user ID from the database.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates user status and related attributes, enabling the user in Keycloak if approved.
